SELECT
    "id",
    "name",
    "event_space",
    "capacity",
    "address",
    "contactinfo"
FROM
    "eventspaces"
WHERE
    LOWER(TRIM("event_space")) IN ('banquet hall', 'conference room')
    AND CAST("capacity" AS INTEGER) >= 200;
115:
SELECT
    i."id" AS internship_id,
    i."title" AS internship_title,
    r."responsibility" AS responsibility
FROM
    "internships" i
JOIN
    "internships_responsibilities" ir ON i."id" = ir."internshipid"
JOIN
    "responsibilities" r ON ir."responsibilityid" = r."id"
ORDER BY
    i."id", r."responsibility";
264:
SELECT
    p."title" AS job_position,
    sd."salary_range" AS salary_range
FROM
    "position" p
LEFT JOIN
    "salarydetails" sd ON p."id" = sd."positionid";
279:
SELECT DISTINCT f."type" AS rental_property_location
FROM "facilities" f
WHERE LOWER(f."type") LIKE '%rental%'
   OR LOWER(f."type") LIKE '%аренд%';
